summary: You can love the routine you have and still be tired of what it requires you to keep giving up.
body: You can love the routine you have and still be tired of what it requires you to keep giving up. When the Moon opposes Lilith, the comfort of a familiar relationship, home, family arrangement, or daily rhythm can come directly up against a need you have been treating as disruptive. Maybe keeping the peace means you get less privacy, less rest, less help, or less say. The familiar arrangement may still give you something valuable. That does not make its cost imaginary. Name what you keep sacrificing before you decide that familiarity alone is enough reason to keep things the same.
